# AggregateError.Errors property

Gets the immediate child errors as they were combined.

This is not flattened — nested [`AggregateError`](../AggregateError.md) instances appear as single entries. For the fully flattened list of leaf errors, use [`FlattenedErrors`](./FlattenedErrors.md) or [`Details`](../Error/Details.md).
